description: Read, write, or delete project and program intent descriptions. Project intent describes the purpose of a project. Program intent (.DS file) describes what a specific program does. Omit 'text' and 'delete' to read. Provide 'text' to write. Set 'delete: true' to remove.

delete.description: Set true to delete the intent

name.description: Program name (without extension). Omit for project-level intent

text.description: Intent text to write. Omit to read current intent

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_intent
